result:
Comment authors now get an Edit Comment button that opens a form drawer. Saving shows a "Comment Updated" success notification. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds a PATCH to `/comments/{commentId}` with the new `body`, validated by a Zod schema. On success it refreshes the comments list for that discussion.
- **Notification:** `docs/api-layer.md` says the success notification belongs in the mutation hook's `onSuccess`, not in components. I put it there. The existing create and delete components do it the other way, so I didn't copy them.
- **UI:** `components/update-comment.tsx` is a drawer with a body textarea, prefilled with the current text.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` rule in `lib/authorization.tsx` that allows only the comment's author, so admins don't see Edit on other people's comments. `comments-list.tsx` wraps the button in it.
- **Mock API:** I added a PATCH handler to the MSW comments handlers so the feature works in dev and tests. It only updates comments owned by the signed-in user.
